visualCharacteristics: Editorial gallery of content cards. The first card is featured — wider, with a dark text panel beside its image; the remaining cards are narrower with an image on top and text below. Each card has an eyebrow label, a title, and a 'Learn more' link.
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Cards'). Each card is one row with two cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = eyebrow label + title (heading) + CTA link.
usage: 'Our latest and greatest' style featured editorial/content promo gallery.
